newsitem.title: USA: AA Cargo Q1 cargo freight revenue up.
newsitem.headline: AA Cargo Q1 cargo freight revenue up.

text.p: American Airlines Cargo said on Friday that despite a decline in capacity, its freight revenue for the first quarter of 1997 was up 1.8 percent.
Yield was up 4.9 percent, the company said, offsetting a 3 percent decrease in traffic.

"In spite of significant increases in passenger load factors and a decline in capacity, we experienced increases in freight revenue, particularly due to traffic increases in South America and the Pacific Rim," said AA Cargo president Dave Brooks.
AA Cargo flew 479,750 million cargo ton miles in the first quarter. A cargo ton mile is one ton of cargo carried one mile. Freight ton miles flown for the quarter were 385,505, AA Cargo said.
AA Cargo is a cargo division of American Airlines.
